attacks.name: Supersonic Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!critical| |!block| |*Dash|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_small|.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Velocity|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make a |*Supersonic Strike| attack. This attack may not target the original defender.

attacks.name: Cyclonic Vortex
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_medium|.

superPowers.name: Speedster
superPowers.body: This character drops all objective tokens it is holding. Then it Advances |!range_large|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Can‘t Catch Me
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack, you may use this superpower. This character Advances |!range_small|. If, at the end of the Advance, this character is outside of the attack's |!range| or the attacker's LOS, the attack ends. If it is the attacker's Activation and the attack did not target multiple characters, the attacker may make another action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Supersonic Reflexes
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against an |!physical| or |!energy| attack or making a dodge roll, it may reroll up to 2 of its defense or dodge dice.
